:::{#exm-heterosked}
#### A heteroskedastic binary outcome

In @exm-cond-variance,

$$
\begin{aligned}
\Var{Y \mid X = 0} &= 0.24 \\
&\ne 0.16 \\
&= \Var{Y \mid X = 1},
\end{aligned}
$$

so $Y$ is heteroskedastic with respect to $X$.
More generally, a binary outcome with $\P(Y = 1 \mid X = x) = \prob(x)$
has conditional variance $\prob(x)(1 - \prob(x))$,
so it is homoskedastic only if $\prob(x)$ takes at most two values, $\prob$ and $1 - \prob$, for some $\prob$.

:::
